Name: Ice Cream Cows (A Cow Expansion Mod)
Author: UncleArya
Description:
[size=3][b]Visit Marnie to buy new Ice Cream Cows after you have built a barn on your farm!
[/b]7 colourful cows to make milks, ice cream, and ice cream cakes with each flavour having a unique buff.
[b]
Types of Cows:
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Vanilla[/size]
[*][size=3]Chocolate[/size]
[*][size=3]Strawberry[/size]
[*][size=3]Caramel[/size]
[*][size=3]Mint[/size]
[*][size=3]Rainbow[/size]
[*][size=3]Cookies 'N Cream[/size]
[/list][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/tknlCXV.png[/img]
Ice Cream Cows produce milk every 2 days (configurable) and will produce large milks once you reach 2 friendship hearts (also configurable).

Milk produced by the Ice Cream Cows can be used in the Ice Cream Machine to make new ice creams, or can be put in the Cheese Press to make cheese (not flavoured).

[size=3]Milk can be turned into Whipped Cream[/size], which is an ingredient in Ice Cream Cake. The cooking recipe for Whipped Cream unlocks at Farming Level 2.


[b]Ice Cream Machine[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0EXBALk.png[/img]

The Ice Cream Machine is used to turn flavoured milk into yummy ice cream. Place a milk into the machine to make its corresponding ice cream. The crafting recipe for the Ice Cream Machine is unlocked at Farming level 4. Once it’s unlocked, it is also for sale at Marnie’s.

Milk from default dairy cows can also be used in the Ice Cream Machine to make ice cream. The selling price of default ice cream has been increased to align with the sell price of the new flavoured ice creams.

Ice cream will be available for sale at the Ice Cream stand in Pelican Town and at the Resort Bar on Ginger Island. The flavor is randomized each day.

The Ice Cream Machine works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url].


[b]Ice Cream Cake[/b]
Once the Ice Cream Machine is unlocked, you can start finding ice cream cake recipes. You will receive a letter in the mail letting you know they are available. To unlock the recipes, you will need to complete certain milestones before receiving the recipe in the mail. 

How to obtain the ice cream cake recipes:
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zCPdXEV.png[/img]
[/spoiler]
[size=3]Ice cream cakes will be available for sale at the Stardrop Saloon starting in Year 2. The flavour is randomized each day. [/size]


[b]Buffs[/b]
Food buffs have been added to milk, ice cream and ice cream cake based on the flavour.
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/c52DBhS.png[/img]
[/spoiler]

[b]Config Options[/b]
You can easily configure some aspects of the mod from the config.json or by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url], including:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Cow purchase and sell price[/size]
[*][size=3]Sell price for milk, ice cream and ice cream cake[/size]
[*][size=3]Purchase price for ice cream and ice cream cake[/size]
[*][size=3]How long for cows to mature and days between producing milk[/size]
[*][size=3]Ice cream machine purchase price and processing time[/size]
[*][size=3]Ability to disable ice cream cake cooking recipes, associated mail and cake items.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
